name: Esther
bio: Esther, also called Hadassah, was a Jewish orphan raised by her cousin Mordecai in Susa after her parents' death. When King Ahasuerus searched his empire for a new queen after deposing Vashti, Esther was gathered among the young women brought to the palace and placed under the care of Hegai, keeper of the harem, who favored her above the rest; following Mordecai's instruction, she kept her Jewish identity hidden. After a year of beauty preparations, Esther pleased the king more than any other woman, and he crowned her queen in his seventh year, celebrating with a great feast and a tax relief for the provinces. She continued to follow Mordecai's guidance, and through him reported a plot by two chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, to assassinate the king, which was investigated and the plotters executed (Esther 2:7-23). Her decisive role in saving her people from Haman's plot is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
